item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"8d6b689bea32a76ddc3b-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"提供 TLS 代理的 CA 信任檔、憑證鏈驗證與主機名稱檢查設定，符合用戶端 TLS 信任設定規則。","evidence":"For server certificate verification it is essential to also require a specific certificate with checkHost or checkIP."},{"decision_id":"d921d21db7b59ac76c03-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"內容介紹 TLS 加密包裝與代理設定，未說明工作階段金鑰記錄或封包分析解密流程。","evidence":"The stunnel program is designed to work as TLS encryption wrapper between remote clients and local (inetd-startable) or remote servers."}]}
